purpose: Place actual published panels alongside new Legume-derived results with the same physical observables and explicit unmatched scope.
rules: Published figures are original crops, never synthesized from digitized or fitted data.

Computed curves use native physical values; do not vertically shift, rescale the modulation, or retune a frequency to make a paper overlay unless a separate physically identified control explicitly says so.
Preserve paper panel identity. Additional convergence, sensitivity, or auxiliary analytical controls go in separate figures.
For unavailable panels, display an explicit not-recomputed label rather than filling them with another observable.
Paper windows can conceal valid computed results outside their range; retain the same-window comparison and add a separate full-range view.
A visually matched branch does not establish cross-k mode identity or physical equivalence.

x.label: k_parallel
x.display_segment_lengths: equal in published panel; label path convention explicitly

B.references: Red dotted horizontal lines at Gamma and X static band frequencies.
B.warning: Caption says all shown modes are above the light lines. Do not use isolated-cylinder Q=500 as array damping.

C.observable: isolated-cylinder rotationally averaged normalized scattering cross section
C.scope: isolated particle, not periodic Legume array; mark unavailable if no isolated scattering computation

D.observable: weak-modulation real quasifrequency near half drive

y.label: Re(omega_tilde)/omega_m
y.range_note: No other numeric tick labels; do not invent exact plotted y-limits.

D.annotation: Finite bandgap; light gray fill only between actual reproduced gap edges.
D.gap_definition: pair is locked to Re(omega_tilde)/omega_m = 0.5; exact degeneracy needs numerical tolerance stated

E.observable: imaginary quasifrequencies inside weak momentum gap

y.label: Im(omega_tilde)/omega_m
y.range_status: visual estimate from labeled tick spacing

E.annotation: Delta theta = 4 degrees is the paper value; do not add it as a measured reproduction result unless computed.
E.time_convention: exp(-i*omega*t), positive imaginary part means growth

F.observable: imaginary quasifrequencies inside strong momentum gap

y.label: Im(omega_tilde)/omega_m
y.range_status: lower exact labeled bound; upper from tick-spacing visual reading

F.annotation: Full bandgap is a paper claim; only use that title for a demonstrated computed complete path, and do not infer full 2D BZ gap from boundary alone.

material_contract.known_source_locations: main p5, SI S1 pp3-4; ref59 public author data description
material_contract.author_data_description: Ge substrate and Ge film both tabulated nk, non-parametric. No unique causal continuation or instantaneous epsilon_infinity is specified by these finite real-axis tables.
material_contract.fallback_scope: A transparent stated constant dielectric or independently fitted tabulated material is an approximate model, not recovered paper coefficients. A material-data fit must not target the paper gap/curve.

lpr.version_warning: arXiv v1 figure_3.pdf is the slab example corresponding to published (c,d), not a higher-resolution version of published (a,b). arXiv figure_2.pdf is another scattering figure. Do not substitute either for the metasurface paper panel.
lpr.primary_reproduction_scope: periodic metasurface green-circle branch of (a) and its static eigenfield row in (b)

parameters.amplitude: absolute relative-permittivity increment, not divided by epsilon_u

a.observable: real eigenfrequency shift relative to same unmodulated resonance

x.label: Modulation amplitude
x.range_status: lower inferred from raster log-tick positions; upper labeled

a.reference: black dashed quadratic scaling guide; its intercept is not a measured prediction
a.digitization_precision: rough raster read, approximately 15-20 percent; not author numerical data
a.coefficient_context: green digitized ratio shift/amplitude^2 approximately 0.27, no amplitude correction factor authorized

b.observable: magnitude of static eigenmode electric field

colorbar.label: |E| (arb. units)
colorbar.palette_description: dark blue-purple through magenta/orange to yellow-white

b.normalization: arbitrary field magnitude, no absolute normalization inferred from image
b.comparison_rule: Use total |E|, not |E|^2 or one component. Show physical geometry outline. Preserve x-z aspect ratio; annotate any expanded plot domain. Field appearance alone does not prove mode identity.
